walkthroughs.title: Get started with Roost
walkthroughs.description: Claude and Codex tabs, Teams, Jira and Confluence, and your pull requests, in one place.

steps.title: Sign in to GitHub
steps.description:
Sign in to GitHub first: your company's tools may download through it, and the PRs tab shows the PRs waiting on you.
[Sign In to GitHub](command:roost.githubSignIn)

steps.title: Connect Claude
steps.description:
Choose how Claude runs: your company's gateway when it has one; otherwise a gateway, a Claude subscription, an Anthropic API key or AWS Bedrock. Only using Codex? Click Not Now, then open a Codex tab: its footer signs you in (ChatGPT login, an OpenAI API key or Bedrock).
[Connect Claude](command:perch.connectClaude)
[Not Now](command:roost.connectClaudeNotNow)

steps.title: Talk to Claude or Codex
steps.description:
Open a tab and type a message. Claude and Codex tabs work the same way; use whichever you are signed in to.
[New Claude Tab](command:roost.newClaudeTab)
[New Codex Tab](command:roost.newCodexTab)

steps.title: Connect your tools
steps.description:
Sign in to the tools your company set up for Claude, and Claude Code gets them.
[Connect Your Tools](command:roost.connectTools)
[Not Now](command:roost.toolsNotNow)

steps.title: Search your code by meaning
steps.description:
Give Claude and Codex tabs a tool that searches the workspace, by keywords and, once installed, by meaning. Off unless you turn it on.
[Turn On Codebase Search](command:roost.codebaseSearchOn)
[Not Now](command:roost.codebaseSearchNotNow)

steps.title: Sign in to Teams
steps.description:
Read and answer your Teams chats without leaving the editor.
[Sign In to Teams](command:roost.teamsSignIn)

steps.title: Connect Jira and Confluence
steps.description:
Sign in with your Atlassian site, email and an API token, in the Jira view.
[Connect Jira](command:roost.jiraSignIn)

steps.title: Sign in to GitHub
steps.description:
The PRs tab shows the PRs waiting on you, using the GitHub CLI's sign-in.
[Sign In to GitHub](command:roost.githubSignIn)

steps.title: Choose your parts
steps.description:
Switch off any part you don't use; the rest carries on.
[Open Roost Settings](command:roost.openSettings)
